verdict.rationale: Cactus is an on-device model, inference and fine-tuning platform, so event-triggered automation is a fair question for it. However, no evidence shows a user-definable rules or trigger engine. Its tool-calling model (Needle), which maps text or speech to tool calls, is a developer building block, and automatic confidence-based cloud routing is a fixed built-in behavior, not user-defined rules on events.
